description: This file defines the ClaimService class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin, providing methods to interact with claim data via ClaimDao and generate reference IDs based on date and next claim ID.

classes.name: ClaimService
classes.description: Provides services related to claim processing, including generating unique reference IDs.

methods.name: getClaimDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ClaimDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Generates a unique reference ID by concatenating the current date in YYYYMMDD format and the next claim ID padded to 7 digits.
